title: Swimmers warned of toxic algae at newly designated Thames bathing site
content: Swimmers are being warned not to enter the water at the first official bathing site on the River Thames, in south-west London, because of toxic blue-green algae in the water. The blue-green algal blooms are rare in moving water but are likely to be caused by the extreme heat, low river flow, and nutrient pollution from sewage waste. Thames Water's Hogsmill sewage treatment plant is situated three miles upstream of the Ham bathing site. The algae discovery raises further questions about plans by Thames Water to pump 75m litres of treated sewage a day into the river near the bathing spot, in a water recycling scheme that is in the pre-application stage. A member of the swimming group that successfully applied for the bathing water designation said: 'This is so unusual to get blue-green algae in a moving body of water. It is the first time in nearly six years of swimming here that this has happened. The river is very low-flowing at the moment because of the lack of rain and the high temperatures we are having. With climate change, this is likely to happen more.' The recycling scheme has been opposed by the local MP, the council, and river users. But it has been designated a strategic infrastructure project, which means it can be pushed through over the heads of the local authority. Campaigners argue that the recycling project will provide only 75m litres of water a day while putting the river under huge environmental pressure. This is a fraction of the 570m litres of water the company leaks every day. Thames Water has been in breach of its permit conditions at its Hogsmill works, which means it has discharged raw sewage in breach of the law. The Environment Agency has put up a sign at the swimming spot to warn swimmers. It reads: 'Do not enter the water. Do not let pets enter the water.' The bathing spot, designated in May, was the first on the Thames in London.
translation: 由于水中出现有毒蓝绿藻，游泳者被警告不要进入泰晤士河首个官方游泳区——位于伦敦西南部哈姆的水域。蓝绿藻华在流动水体中十分罕见，但很可能是极端高温、河流流量低以及污水中的营养物污染造成的。泰晤士水务公司的霍格斯米尔污水处理厂位于哈姆游泳区上游三英里处。藻类的发现进一步引发了人们对泰晤士水务公司计划的质疑：该公司打算在靠近游泳区的地方每天向河中泵入7500万升处理过的污水，这是一项处于预申请阶段的水循环计划。成功申请该游泳区称号的游泳团体一名成员表示：在流动水体中出现蓝绿藻太不寻常了。这是我在这里游泳近六年来第一次遇到。由于缺雨和高温，目前河流流量非常低。随着气候变化，这种情况可能会更常发生。水循环计划遭到当地议员、市政会和河流使用者的反对，但它已被指定为战略性基础设施项目，这意味着它可以绕过地方当局强行推进。活动人士认为，该循环项目每天只提供7500万升水，却让河流承受巨大的环境压力，而这只占该公司每天泄漏的5.7亿升水的一小部分。泰晤士水务公司在霍格斯米尔工厂违反许可条件，意味着它非法排放了未经处理的污水。环境署已在游泳点竖立警示牌，上面写着：请勿下水。请勿让宠物下水。该游泳区于5月被指定，是伦敦泰晤士河上的第一个。

title: Climate crisis fuelling steep fall in migratory bird numbers
content: It may still feel like summer, but in the world of birds, autumn migration is already well under way. Cuckoos and swifts have already left us, and while swallows and many species of warbler will not depart our shores until September, many species of Arctic-breeding waders have begun to stop off at our coastal marshes to refuel for their long journey south. This year, however, there could be fewer than usual. A review by the British Trust for Ornithology, working with other international conservation organisations, has found that more than half of these global travellers are suffering major declines in numbers – a worrying downward trend. Many of those under threat use the African-Eurasian flyway, one of the largest mass-migration systems on the planet. Among many and complex causes of these declines, including habitat loss, disease and pesticide use, one stands out: the climate crisis. It is not just the long-term effects of major shifts that affect migratory birds, but also the extreme weather events that have become far more frequent and intense. The current heatwave across so much of Europe is only the latest – and definitely not the last – of these. The report calls for conservation strategies that address all of these threats across birds' lifecycles and along all of the international flyways, combined with efforts closer to home to create and preserve habitats for these vulnerable species.
translation: 现在或许仍感觉像夏天，但在鸟类的世界里，秋季迁徙早已全面展开。杜鹃和雨燕已经离开，燕子与许多种类的莺要到九月才会离岸，而许多在北极繁殖的涉禽已经开始在沿海沼泽落脚补给，为漫长的南下之旅补充能量。然而，今年的数量可能比往常更少。英国鸟类学信托基金会与多家国际保护组织联合开展的一项评估发现，这些全球旅行者中有一半以上数量大幅下降——这是一个令人担忧的下行趋势。许多受威胁的鸟类使用非洲-欧亚迁徙通道，这是地球上最大的候鸟迁徙系统之一。在这些数量下降的诸多复杂原因中——包括栖息地丧失、疾病和农药使用——有一个尤为突出：气候危机。影响候鸟的不仅是重大气候变化的长期效应，还有变得更加频繁和剧烈的极端天气事件。席卷欧洲大片地区的当前热浪，只是其中最新的一次——而且绝不是最后一次。该报告呼吁采取保护策略，在鸟类的整个生命周期内、沿着所有国际迁徙通道应对这些威胁，同时配合在本土创造和保留栖息地的努力，以保护这些脆弱的物种。
summary: 评估显示超半数全球迁徙候鸟数量大幅下降，气候危机与极端天气是突出原因，亟需全生命周期与全域保护。

title: Calls for urgent law change as UK's largest water reuse system cannot be switched on
content: The largest water reuse system in the UK, which could save thousands of litres of water a day for people living in one of the driest regions of the country, is not allowed to be switched on because of drinking water regulations. As water supplies in England reach critical levels, the Guardian can reveal that a model water recycling system within an urban housing development in Cambridgeshire has not been switched on since it was made ready in 2021. Thousands of residents could be saving about 25 litres per person per day by using recycled rainwater in their homes for non-drinking purposes. But the water reuse system has been switched off because the Drinking Water Inspectorate (DWI) deems it is not in line with the law. The block to the water reuse scheme, and others that water companies want to install, is hampering attempts to bring in large-scale water recycling schemes for new developments and tackle the extreme water shortages the country faces by 2055, experts warn. The chair of the UK Water Reuse Association said the block needed to be removed urgently and the system copied at scale across the country. Rainwater harvesting and grey water recycling are well-proven and sustainable technologies that have been implemented internationally at scale for years. The UK is lagging behind. In homes it can save 20 to 25 litres of water per person per day. Other countries in Europe, such as Belgium and Germany, have had reuse systems operating for more than 20 years. The Environment Agency has predicted a water demand gap in England of 5bn litres a day by 2055 unless urgent action is taken. In March, the DWI created a framework for rainwater harvesting and grey water reuse in homes, after being told to act by ministers. Its report recommended the law be changed to allow dual-use water systems in homes.
translation: 英国最大的水再利用系统本可为全国最干旱地区之一的居民每天节省数千升水，却因饮用水法规而无法启用。在英格兰供水达到临界水平之际，《卫报》披露，剑桥郡一个城市住宅开发区内的模范水循环系统自2021年建成以来一直没有启用。数千居民本可通过在家庭中利用回收雨水进行非饮用用途，每人每天节约约25升水。但该水再利用系统被关闭，因为饮用水监察局（DWI）认为它不符合法律规定。专家警告，阻碍水再利用计划（以及水务公司希望安装的其他系统）正在妨碍为新开发项目引入大规模水循环计划、应对英国到2055年面临的极端缺水问题。英国水再利用协会主席表示，必须紧急解除埃丁顿的阻碍，并在全国推广这一系统。雨水收集和灰水循环是经过充分验证的可持续技术，已在国际上规模化实施多年，英国正在落后。在家中，它可以为每人每天节省20到25升水。比利时和德国等欧洲国家的水再利用系统已运行20多年。环境署预测，除非采取紧急行动，否则到2055年英格兰的供水缺口将达每天50亿升。3月，在被部长们要求采取行动后，DWI 为住宅雨水收集和灰水再利用制定了框架，其报告建议修改法律，允许住宅使用双用途供水系统。
summary: 英国最大水再利用系统因30多年前的饮用水法规无法启用，专家呼吁修法推广以应对2055年每天50亿升的供水缺口。

title: US gross national debt tops $40tn for first time
content: US debt reached $40tn for the first time on Wednesday, the US treasury department said, after the government deficit doubled over the last decade. The treasury's latest debt balance showed $40.047tn, the highest in US history. The milestone marks years of government spending that grew under both Donald Trump and Joe Biden. During his first term, Trump approved $8.4tn worth of debt, with a huge chunk going to Covid-19 relief spending, while Biden approved $4.3tn worth of debt. In fiscal year 2026, $1.8tn has been added to the debt so far, with a big chunk of new government spending dedicated to tariff refunds, which have totaled $100bn so far. Government spending watchdog groups have anticipated for weeks the US surpassing the $40tn threshold after debt reached $39tn in March. For perspective, it took nearly 200 years for America's gross debt to reach $1 trillion for the first time in 1981, said the president of a budget watchdog group. $40 trillion of debt doesn't exist solely on the government's ledgers; it is felt throughout the economy and finds its way to the pocketbooks of people one way or another. The more we borrow, the more we exacerbate inflation, squeeze out other priorities in the budget, and leave ourselves vulnerable to emergencies at home and turmoil abroad. The threshold was breached as Congress remains at an impasse over its latest spending bill. The US House and Senate passed two different bills that would fund the federal government, which is scheduled to shut down on 30 September if a bill isn't adopted by both chambers and signed by the president. Earlier, the US treasury announced it would double its buyback of government debt after the bond market balked at ongoing inflation and continued conflict between the US and Iran.
translation: 美国财政部表示，在政府赤字过去十年翻了一番之后，美国国债周三首次达到40万亿美元。财政部最新的债务余额显示为40.047万亿美元，创美国历史最高纪录。这一里程碑标志着唐纳德·特朗普和乔·拜登执政期间政府支出不断增长。在第一个任期内，特朗普批准了8.4万亿美元的债务，其中很大一部分用于新冠救助支出，而拜登批准了4.3万亿美元的债务。在2026财年，迄今为止已新增1.8万亿美元债务，其中新增政府支出的大头用于关税退税，迄今总额已达1000亿美元。政府支出监督组织数周来一直预期美国将突破40万亿美元大关，因为3月份债务已达到39万亿美元。一个预算监督组织的主席表示，从历史角度看，美国总债务在1981年首次达到1万亿美元花了近200年。40万亿美元的债务不仅存在于政府的账簿上，它渗透到整个经济中，并以这样或那样的方式落到每个人的钱包上。我们借得越多，就越加剧通货膨胀、挤占预算中的其他优先事项，并让我们在国内外紧急情况和动荡面前更加脆弱。突破这一门槛之际，国会正就其最新的支出法案陷入僵局。美国众议院和参议院通过了两个不同的拨款法案，如果两院不能通过同一法案并由总统签署，联邦政府将于9月30日停摆。此前，在债券市场对持续的通胀以及美伊之间的持续冲突表示抗拒后，美国财政部宣布将把政府债务回购规模翻倍。
summary: 美国国债首次突破40万亿美元，源于多年赤字扩张；借债加剧通胀并挤占预算，国会僵局还可能导致政府停摆。

title: British energy bills forecast to hit three-year high this winter
content: Household energy bills across Great Britain are expected to climb to a three-year high this winter as the impact of the Middle East war wipes out Andy Burnham's tax cut on electricity bills. The government's cap on energy prices is on track to rise by 4% from this October to the equivalent of £1,729 a year, which could hit struggling households especially hard this winter, according to analysis by the energy consultancy Cornwall Insight. The forecast quarterly price cap would be the highest since July 2023, after soaring energy market prices from the Middle East were compounded by the increased use of expensive gas in power plants during heatwaves across Europe. The rising cost of gas will more than offset the new prime minister's promise to cut VAT from household electricity bills from October, which aimed to give voters some breathing space on living costs by shrinking bills by an average of £45 a year. A principal consultant at Cornwall Insight said: 'It is a stark reminder that our energy bills remain tied to events thousands of miles away. Moments like this are the strongest argument for reducing Britain's reliance on volatile international gas. While temporary relief like VAT cuts help soften the blow, they don't touch the underlying fact that Britain is heavily dependent on imports of natural gas. As long as we're exposed to global markets, the risk of these price shocks will remain.' The analysts have estimated that electricity rates will rise from 26.11p a kilowatt hour to 26.57p, and gas charges will rise from 7.33p to 7.90p. The consultancy expects bills to rise again in January based on current market prices, although this could change depending on developments in the Middle East.
translation: 预计英国各地家庭能源账单今冬将攀升至三年高位，因为中东战争的影响抵消了安迪·伯纳姆对电费的减税政策。能源咨询公司康沃尔洞察的分析显示，政府能源价格上限自10月起将上涨4%，折合每年1729英镑，这可能让今冬本已举步维艰的家庭尤其受伤。在来自中东的能源市场价格飙升、叠加欧洲热浪期间发电厂增加使用昂贵天然气之后，这一预测的季度价格上限将是2023年7月以来的最高水平。不断上涨的天然气成本将大大抵消新首相从10月起削减家庭电费增值税的承诺——该承诺本意是通过每年平均减少45英镑账单，为选民的生活成本松一口气。康沃尔洞察的一位首席顾问表示：这清楚地提醒我们，能源账单仍然与千里之外的事件息息相关。这样的时刻是减少英国对波动的国际天然气依赖的最有力论据。虽然增值税减免等临时救济有助于缓解冲击，但它们触及不到根本事实：英国严重依赖进口天然气。只要我们暴露在全球市场中，价格冲击的风险就会持续存在。分析师估计，电价将从每千瓦时26.11便士上涨到26.57便士，天然气价格将从7.33便士上涨到7.90便士。该咨询公司预计，根据当前市场价格，账单1月还会再次上涨，尽管这可能取决于中东局势的发展。
summary: 中东冲突推高天然气价格，英国能源账单预计涨至三年高位，减税难以抵消，凸显对进口能源的脆弱依赖。

title: Jaecoo owner Chery takes 'next step' in UK push with R&D centre
content: The Chinese carmaker behind the irreverently nicknamed Temu Range Rover is plotting further UK expansion with a major research and development centre in England. Chery, which makes the Jaecoo and Omoda car brands, said the launch of a new R&D site was the next step in our long-term plan for Britain as it also moves towards manufacturing its cars in the UK. Chery's sales are growing at breakneck pace in Britain. In July, the Chery, Omoda and Jaecoo brands accounted for nearly 8% of UK market share, up from 3% last year. The China-built Jaecoo 7, known as the Temu Range Rover for its low price and techy add-ons, became the top-selling model in the UK in March, but Chery currently has to bring it in from abroad. The company is part-owned by the Chinese state and has already signed a deal with Nissan to build its cars at its Sunderland plant, in a move that would begin mass-market Chinese car production in Britain for the first time from 2027. The new R&D facility would open in late autumn, Chery said. An existing vehicle testing centre in Bedfordshire will be the site of Chery's new R&D facility. The centre will give Chery access to more than 70km of purpose-built test tracks for it to fine-tune its cars for UK roads. Further down the line it will also use the site to work on self-driving cars and artificial intelligence. Chinese manufacturers' arrival as a major force in the car industry has put enormous pressure on traditional European rivals. Chinese companies have been able to undercut European companies in building electrified cars because of state subsidies, lower labour costs and the country's dominance in the battery industry. Chery said it eventually planned to recruit local talent and create engineering jobs in the area – but did not say how much it would invest in the site or how many jobs would be created.
translation: 打造了被戏称为 Temu 版路虎揽胜的中国汽车制造商，正通过在英国设立大型研发中心谋划进一步扩张。生产 Jaecoo 和 Omoda 两个汽车品牌的奇瑞表示，新研发基地的启动是其在英国长期计划中的下一步，公司同时也在推进在英国本土制造汽车。奇瑞在英国的销量正以惊人速度增长。7月，奇瑞、Omoda 和 Jaecoo 三个品牌合计占英国市场份额近8%，高于去年的3%。中国制造的 Jaecoo 7 因其低价和科技感配置而被称为 Temu 版路虎揽胜，3月成为英国最畅销车型，但奇瑞目前仍需从国外进口。这家公司部分归中国政府所有，已与日产签署协议，在其桑德兰工厂生产汽车——此举将标志着中国汽车首次从2027年起在英国开展大众市场生产。奇瑞表示，新研发设施将于深秋启用。位于贝德福德郡的一个现有车辆测试中心将成为奇瑞新研发基地的所在地。该中心将让奇瑞使用超过70公里的专用测试跑道，针对英国道路微调其汽车。未来它还将利用该场地开发自动驾驶汽车和人工智能。中国制造商作为汽车行业一支重要力量的到来，给传统欧洲竞争对手带来了巨大压力。凭借政府补贴、较低劳动力成本以及该国在电池行业的主导地位，中国企业在制造电动汽车方面能够以低于欧洲企业的价格竞争。奇瑞表示，最终计划在当地招募人才、创造工程岗位，但未透露将投资多少或创造多少就业。
summary: 中国车企奇瑞以惊人速度抢占英国市场，设研发中心并签约日产本土生产，对欧洲传统车企形成巨大压力。

title: All power to the UK competition watchdog's war on 'drip pricing'
content: The Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) is on-message with the prime minister's declaration of war on the small – and sometimes not-so-small – hassles and expenses of everyday consumer life created by companies' underhand and misleading pricing tactics. Trainline, Virgin Atlantic and Red Driving School found themselves under investigation on Wednesday for various forms of alleged drip pricing – not being upfront about mandatory add-on charges, in other words. The watchdog's consumer protection drive pre-dates the prime minister's arrival and was encouraged by legislation under the last government – the Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act of 2024, which gave the regulator direct enforcement powers, meaning it no longer had to go to court under consumer protection laws. And it is using those powers: eight cases were opened last November and driving schools plus a ticketing site have already been fined. This is very welcome. Putting a few household names in the spotlight sends a usefully strong message. By way of boosting that signal, shares in Trainline, the only quoted company on Wednesday's list, plunged by 14%. It's merely an investigation at this stage, so one can't draw conclusions, but there was a curious line in Trainline's statement: 'Trainline has proactively engaged with the CMA over several months and is taking steps to enhance the presentation of certain fees.' The obvious question is why, if the regulator has been on the warpath for months, Trainline didn't just give it everything it wanted on day one. There may be complicating details. Trainline adds its value for consumers by navigating the hellishly complicated fare structures on Britain's railways. But such dry technicalities were, presumably, mentioned in the months of engagement with the CMA. To repeat, no wrongdoing has been found. But the investigation comes at a bad moment as Trainline waits to see if the state gets round to launching a rival fee-free ticketing app.
translation: 英国竞争与市场管理局（CMA）与首相向日常消费生活中那些由企业暗中误导性定价手段造成的小麻烦——有时并非小麻烦——宣战的态度一致。周三，Trainline、维珍大西洋航空和 Red 驾校因各种涉嫌滴灌定价的行为而受到调查——说白了，就是不明示强制性的附加费用。该监管机构的消费者保护行动早于首相上任，并受到上届政府立法的推动——2024年的《数字市场、竞争与消费者法》赋予监管机构直接执法权，意味着它不再需要依据消费者保护法上法庭。而且它正在使用这些权力：去年11月立案八起，驾校和一个票务网站已被罚款。这非常值得欢迎。让几个家喻户晓的名字处于聚光灯下，发出了一个有力而有益的信号。为了增强这一信号的效果，周三名单上唯一上市的 Trainline 股价暴跌14%。目前还只是调查阶段，不能下结论，但 Trainline 的声明中有一句话耐人寻味：Trainline 已主动与 CMA 接触数月，并正在采取措施改善某些费用的展示方式。显而易见的问题是：如果监管机构数月来一直在穷追猛打，为什么 Trainline 不一开始就满足其一切要求？也许存在复杂的细节。Trainline 通过驾驭英国铁路极其复杂的票价结构为消费者创造价值。但这类枯燥的技术细节，想必在其与 CMA 数月的接触中早已提及。再说一遍，尚未发现任何不当行为。但这场调查来得不是时候，因为 Trainline 正观望国家是否会推出一个免费的竞争性购票应用。
summary: 英国反垄断机构依据新法打击滴灌定价，调查 Trainline 等三家大公司，股价应声下跌，监管信号强烈。

Trainline 股价暴跌14%，已有多家机构被罚款
为何不早早整改存疑；调查恰逢国家或推免费购票应用竞争

title: Oxfam 'can't guarantee future' of charity shops as it reviews warehouse business
content: Oxfam is reviewing the operations of its three warehouses in Batley, Bicester and Milton Keynes and says it cannot give guarantees on the future of its high street shops in a difficult economic climate. The charity said it had no plans to close warehouses or shops but insiders fear that Batley, which houses Oxfam's main textile recycling centre, will shut as part of a cost-cutting drive because the West Yorkshire site's lease is up for renewal. All three warehouses together employ about 90 people. A source said Oxfam was considering closing up to 100 of its 500-plus UK outlets as sales at some were no longer viable. 'Donations have dropped off,' the insider said, adding that the charity's shops were also facing competition from online sellers of secondhand goods such as Vinted. 'Oxfam is always more expensive, and that's starting to have an effect.' Oxfam Activities made losses of more than £2m in the year to March 2025 and in the prior year. Sales fell by 7% in the year to March 2025, driven by a slump in income from recycling. A chief officer of Oxfam GB said: 'As is standard practice, we keep all parts of our retail operations under review via regular meetings. While we cannot give guarantees in this difficult economic climate, we are confident in and positive about our current retail performance and do not have plans to close our shops or warehouses at this time.' The review of Oxfam's operations comes after job cuts and store closures at charities including the British Heart Foundation and Cancer Research. The BHF closed 150 shops and cut jobs earlier this summer. It blamed rising costs and the shift to online shopping had made about a quarter of its high street locations commercially unsustainable. Charities selling secondhand clothing have also faced increased competition from online sellers such as eBay and Vinted, while the price of rag – damaged or unwanted clothing for recycling – has fallen in recent years.
translation: 乐施会正在审查其位于巴特利、比斯特和米尔顿凯恩斯三个仓库的运营，并表示在艰难的经济环境下无法对高街门店的未来给出保证。该慈善机构表示没有关闭仓库或门店的计划，但内部人士担心，作为削减成本行动的一部分，容纳乐施会主要纺织品回收中心的巴特利仓库将关闭，因为该西约克郡场地的租约即将续期。三个仓库合计雇佣约90人。有消息称，乐施会正考虑关闭其英国500多家门店中的多达100家，因为部分门店的销售已难以为继。捐赠减少了，内部人士说，并补充说，该慈善机构的门店还面临 Vinted 等二手商品在线卖家的竞争。乐施会总是更贵，这开始产生影响。截至2025年3月的一年及前一年，乐施会活动部门亏损超过200万英镑。截至2025年3月的一年销售额下降7%，主要受回收收入下滑拖累。乐施会英国一位主管表示：按照标准做法，我们通过定期会议持续审查零售业务的所有部分。虽然我们无法在这种艰难的经济环境下给出保证，但我们对自己目前的零售表现有信心，并且现阶段没有关闭门店或仓库的计划。在乐施会审查运营之前，英国心脏基金会和癌症研究等慈善机构已出现裁员和门店关闭。英国心脏基金会今年夏初关闭了150家门店并裁员，将原因归咎于成本上升和线上购物转移，这使约四分之一的高街门店在商业上难以为继。销售二手服装的慈善机构还面临 eBay 和 Vinted 等在线卖家在顾客和捐赠方面的竞争加剧，同时碎布——用于回收的破损或不需要的衣物——的价格近年来也在下跌。
summary: 乐施会等慈善机构在捐赠下滑、线上二手平台竞争和成本上升中被迫关店，高街慈善零售模式承压。

title: Dog food recalled in UK after reports of pets losing their sight
content: A dog food brand has recalled all of its fresh meals after reports that a recipe change may have caused some animals to develop an eye condition that, if left untreated, can lead to sight loss. The brand Years said owners should stop feeding its fresh meals to their dogs immediately and also told them not to feed them to any other animal, or to donate or sell them. In response to reports from some owners of pets not responding to treatment and in some cases losing their sight, Years told the Guardian: 'The picture is mixed. Some ophthalmologists report dogs responding well to treatment, others have seen limited or slower responses.' The firm runs a subscription-based service delivering personalised meals and its products are also available at some retailers. Years said that as of the early hours of Wednesday, it had received 192 reports of potential, yet unverified, eye issues out of roughly 40,000 customers. Dry eye in dogs – also known as keratoconjunctivitis sicca, or KCS – occurs when a dog is unable to produce tears, making their eyes very sore. Bilateral means it affects both eyes. A vet group says on its website that affected dogs may rub at their eyes, squint or be sensitive to light. If this condition is not treated early or is not managed effectively, it can lead to visual problems and blindness. Years said on its website that the recall followed reports of some dogs having a potential adverse eye reaction to buckwheat, an ingredient included in its meals. Buckwheat was added to the company's meals several months ago. One dog owner who received the recall notice told the Guardian that their pet had so far shown no symptoms, 'but after eight months on this new food, I'm genuinely worried about whether eye problems are coming'. Years said that as a precaution it was issuing a voluntary recall of all Years fresh meals. The investigation has identified buckwheat as a potential contributing factor, and that includes investigating potential contamination within the buckwheat supply.
translation: 一家狗粮品牌已召回其全部鲜食产品，因为有报告称，配方变更可能导致一些动物患上一种若不加治疗会导致失明的眼部疾病。Years 品牌表示，宠物主人应立即停止给狗喂食其鲜食产品，并告知他们不要喂给任何其他动物，也不要捐赠或出售。针对一些宠物主人反映宠物对治疗无反应、部分甚至失明的情况，Years 告诉《卫报》：情况很复杂。一些眼科医生报告狗对治疗反应良好，另一些则看到反应有限或较慢。该公司运营着一种订阅式服务，提供个性化餐食，其产品也在一些零售商店有售。Years 表示，截至周三凌晨，在约4万名客户中，已收到192份潜在但未经证实的眼部问题报告。狗的干眼症——又称干性角膜结膜炎（KCS）——发生在狗无法产生泪液时，使眼睛非常疼痛。双侧意味着双眼都受影响。一家兽医组织在其网站上表示，受影响的狗可能会揉眼睛、眯眼或对光敏感。如果这种疾病不及时治疗或得不到有效控制，可能导致视力问题和失明。Years 在其网站上表示，此次召回是在有报告称一些狗对荞麦（其餐食中的一种成分）产生潜在不良眼部反应后进行的。荞麦是几个月前加入公司餐食的。一位收到召回通知的狗主人告诉《卫报》，他的宠物目前没有出现症状，但吃了八个月这种新食物后，我真的很担心会不会出现眼部问题。Years 表示，出于预防考虑，正自愿召回其全部鲜食产品。调查已确定荞麦是一个潜在促成因素，并正在调查荞麦供应链内可能存在的污染。
summary: Years 狗粮因配方加入荞麦疑似致宠物干眼症而全面召回，暴露订阅式鲜食产品在质量与信任上的风险。

title: Astronomers detect fastest known star in Milky Way
content: Astronomers have detected the fastest known star in the Milky Way, hurtling around the supermassive black hole at the heart of the galaxy. The star, called S301, travels at about 25,000km per second, 100,000 times faster than a commercial plane. It is also the closest known star to the Milky Way's central black hole, Sagittarius A*, approaching it around the distance of Saturn to the Sun. 'What is special about this star is that it's orbiting Sagittarius A* on a very tight orbit, taking just 8.7 years to complete it, and is approaching the black hole at a mere 12 times the distance of Earth to the sun. That is unprecedented,' said Felix Mang, a PhD student at the Max Planck Institute and an author of the study. The star's extreme proximity to Sagittarius A* means that it could open a new window on to the black hole's fundamental properties and the extreme environment surrounding it. Like many objects in the night sky, black holes are predicted to spin. According to Einstein's general theory of relativity, a spinning black hole drags spacetime along with it, warping the orbits of surrounding stars. This effect is only meaningful for objects orbiting fast-rotating black holes at close range. S301 appears to have the perfect combination of a highly eccentric and very tight orbit. 'For the first time, we would actually be able to measure very directly the spin of a massive black hole, which would be a key test of Einstein's theory,' said a senior scientist and co-author of the study. Previously it had been assumed it would require measuring the motion of multiple stars for several decades to estimate the spin. The scientists were able to trace S301's orbit back to 2017 and, by tracking it through its next closest passage in 2031, hope to have enough data. Although the star is unusually close to the central black hole, it is not expected to cross its event horizon, the point beyond which objects can never escape.
translation: 天文学家探测到了银河系中已知速度最快的恒星，它正环绕银河系中心的超大质量黑洞疾驰。这颗名为 S301 的恒星以约每秒2.5万公里的速度运行，比商用飞机快10万倍。它也是已知距银河系中心黑洞人马座A*最近的恒星，其接近距离约为土星到太阳的距离。马克斯·普朗克研究所博士生、该研究作者之一费利克斯·芒表示：这颗恒星的特殊之处在于，它正沿着一条非常紧密的轨道环绕人马座A*运行，仅需8.7年即可完成一圈，且它接近黑洞的距离仅为地球到太阳距离的12倍。这是前所未有的。S301 与人马座A*的极近距离意味着，它可能为揭示黑洞的基本性质及其周围极端环境打开一扇新窗。像夜空中的许多天体一样，黑洞被预测会自转。根据爱因斯坦的广义相对论，旋转的黑洞会拖拽周围的时空，扭曲附近恒星的轨道。这种效应只对近距离环绕快速旋转黑洞的天体有意义。S301 似乎兼具高度偏心且非常紧密的轨道这一完美组合。该研究共同作者、一位资深科学家表示：我们将首次能够非常直接地测量大质量黑洞的自转，这将成为对爱因斯坦理论的关键检验。此前人们认为，估计自转需要几十年间观测多颗恒星的运动。科学家们已将 S301 的轨道追溯至2017年，并希望通过跟踪它在2031年的下一次最接近时刻，积累足够的数据。尽管这颗恒星异常接近中心黑洞，但它预计不会越过事件视界——越过这一点，任何物体都无法逃脱。
summary: 天文学家发现以每秒2.5万公里疾驰的恒星 S301，它极近银河系中心黑洞，或首次直接测量黑洞自转以检验爱因斯坦理论。
